description: Option A: rich MANUAL logging for Call and WhatsApp on the lead detail page (src/routes/_authenticated/leads/$id.tsx). After initiating the dialer (tel:) or WhatsApp (wa.me), prompt the rep with a small shadcn Dialog to capture the interaction OUTCOME (required), optional duration (call only), and optional notes. Persist as a lead_activities row using the existing payload JSONB column (NO DB migration, NO external/paid API). Update the timeline to render call/whatsapp outcomes nicely while leaving all other activity types unchanged. This is a single self-contained feature; no dependencies on other features.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/leads/$id.tsx, extend logActivity to accept an optional payload arg: change signature to logActivity(type: string, title: string, body?: string, payload?: Record<string, any>) and add `payload: payload ?? {}` to the supabase.from('lead_activities').insert({...}) call. The insert Type accepts payload?: Json (confirmed in src/integrations/supabase/types.ts). Existing callers (note/email/stage_change/followup/reminder) omit the arg and must remain unchanged in behavior (payload defaults to {}).

Add state to LeadDetailPage to drive the new dialog, e.g. const [logInteraction, setLogInteraction] = useState<{ channel: 'call' | 'whatsapp' } | null>(null); plus controlled field state for outcome (string), duration text (string), and notes (string). Reset these when the dialog opens/closes.

Change the Call button onClick (~line 198): keep window.location.href = `tel:${lead.mobile}` to open the dialer, then instead of the old direct logActivity, open the log dialog via setLogInteraction({ channel: 'call' }). Change the WhatsApp button onClick (~line 199): keep window.location.href = `https://wa.me/${lead.mobile.replace(/\D/g,'')}`, then setLogInteraction({ channel: 'whatsapp' }). ASSUMPTION: dialog opens immediately after firing the dialer/WhatsApp link (the browser tab stays open behind the app on mobile); rep fills it in on return. Note this assumption in a code comment.

Add a new shadcn Dialog (reuse the already-imported Dialog/DialogContent/DialogHeader/DialogTitle/DialogDescription/DialogFooter) controlled by open={!!logInteraction}. Title/description adapt to channel: 'Log call' vs 'Log WhatsApp'. Make it mobile-friendly (max-w-md, consistent with the existing 'Reason required' dialog styling).

Inside the dialog, render an Outcome control (required). Use RadioGroup/RadioGroupItem (import from '@/components/ui/radio-group') or Select (already imported) — pick one and stay consistent. Options depend on channel: CALL => Connected / No answer / Busy / Switched off / Wrong number / Call back later. WHATSAPP => Sent / Delivered / Read / Replied / No response. Use a Label for the field.

For CALL only, render an optional Duration input (small Input, already imported) labelled e.g. 'Duration (min)' — store the raw entered text and, if it parses to a number, a normalized numeric minutes value. Keep it simple. Hide this field entirely for whatsapp.
Render an optional Notes Textarea (already imported) labelled 'Notes' for what was discussed. Both channels.

Add a submit handler: build a concise title like `Call — ${outcome}` / `WhatsApp — ${outcome}` (use a plain hyphen with spaces, e.g. 'Call - Connected', to avoid non-ASCII em dash per repo style), body = notes trimmed (or undefined if empty), and payload = { channel, outcome, ...(durationText ? { durationText } : {}), ...(durationMin != null ? { durationMin } : {}) }. Call logActivity(channel, title, body, payload). Disable the submit button when outcome is empty. On submit, close the dialog (setLogInteraction(null)) and reset fields. logActivity already invalidates ['activities', id] so the timeline refreshes.

Update the timeline activity rendering (the activities?.map((a: any) => (...)) block in the Timeline TabsContent). For a.type === 'call' or 'whatsapp' with a populated a.payload, render an enhanced line: a small icon (Phone for call, MessageCircle for whatsapp — already imported), the outcome, and for calls the duration if present, e.g. 'Connected · 3 min' (a middle-dot is acceptable, matches existing ' · ' separators used elsewhere in the file). Show a.body (notes) below as it already does. All other activity types must render exactly as before (title / body / formatDistanceToNow · type).
Do NOT wire any external telephony or WhatsApp Business API. Do NOT add a DB migration or edit generated types. Keep the change confined to $id.tsx (plus the radio-group import if used).
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Call opens the dialer (tel:) and then opens a 'Log call' dialog with outcome options Connected/No answer/Busy/Switched off/Wrong number/Call back later, an optional duration field, and optional notes.
Clicking WhatsApp opens wa.me and then opens a 'Log WhatsApp' dialog with outcome options Sent/Delivered/Read/Replied/No response, and optional notes (no duration field).

Submitting inserts a lead_activities row with type 'call'/'whatsapp', a concise title, body = notes, and payload = { channel, outcome, durationText?, durationMin? }. No columns added; payload is the existing JSONB.
logActivity now accepts and passes payload; all existing call sites (note/email/stage_change/followup/reminder) still compile and behave identically (payload defaults to {}).
Timeline shows call/whatsapp activities with outcome (and duration for calls) plus notes; all other activity types render unchanged.
Timeline refreshes after logging via invalidation of ['activities', id].
No external telephony/WhatsApp API is imported or called; no migration or generated-types edit is introduced.
Change is TypeScript-valid by inspection (correct types, all used components imported).
verification: Code inspection: confirm logActivity signature/insert change, both button onClicks, the new Dialog with correct per-channel outcome sets, duration shown only for call, submit builds title/body/payload and calls logActivity, and the timeline conditional rendering for call/whatsapp.
Confirm RadioGroup (or Select) and all referenced UI components are imported; confirm no non-ASCII em dash is introduced.
grep to confirm no new import of any telephony/WhatsApp API SDK and no changes under supabase migrations or types.ts.
CI will run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `bun run build` on PR (cannot run in sandbox due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY npm 403).
findings: Implemented entirely in src/routes/_authenticated/leads/$id.tsx plus a RadioGroup import from src/components/ui/radio-group.tsx. logActivity now takes optional payload (Record<string,any>) and inserts payload: payload ?? {} (lead_activities.Insert accepts payload?: Json, confirmed in types.ts lines 603-624; activity_type enum already has 'call'/'whatsapp'). Call/WhatsApp buttons fire tel:/wa.me then open a shadcn Dialog (max-w-md) via setLogInteraction({channel}). Dialog uses RadioGroup for required Outcome (CALL: Connected/No answer/Busy/Switched off/Wrong number/Call back later; WHATSAPP: Sent/Delivered/Read/Replied/No response), optional Duration Input (call only, stores durationText + parsed durationMin), optional Notes Textarea. Submit builds title 'Call - <outcome>' / 'WhatsApp - <outcome>' (ASCII hyphen), body = trimmed notes or undefined, payload = { channel, outcome, durationText?, durationMin? }, calls logActivity(channel,...), then closes+resets; submit disabled until an outcome is chosen. Timeline shows an icon (Phone/MessageCircle) + outcome (+ ' · N min' for calls) for call/whatsapp rows with populated payload.outcome; all other activity types render unchanged. No migration, no generated-types edit, no external telephony/WhatsApp API. NOTE: could not run bun install / tsc / build locally (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY npm 403); verified by inspection. CI runs tsc --noEmit + build on PR. No em dashes introduced (pre-existing em dashes remain in unrelated lines 49/268-270/733-734).
